exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 81 postpartum women receiving opioid agonist treatment during pregnancy
finding: Treatment discharge and postbirth opioid misuse were common after delivery, and longer treatment duration before delivery was associated with a lower likelihood of opioid misuse in the month after delivery.
mod_finding: Women who delivered via cesarean section and received a discharge opioid medication were also more likely to engage in opioid misuse in the month after delivery.
